pages.text: Compact items with Compacting and increase real slot capacity with a normal Stack Upgrade.

pages.title: A Tighter Fit
pages.text: Distinguish compacting from capacity; Advanced Filter refines content control and a storage base supports the home branch.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Basic Compacting handles supported 2×2 recipes; advanced also handles 3×3. Stack changes capacity rather than creating material; conversion recipes upgrade an existing upgrade.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Compacting consumes ingredients through supported 2×2 recipes; advanced adds 3×3 and filtering. It is crafting, not capacity expansion.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Stack changes per-slot capacity; Starter/further tiers/conversions follow installed recipes. Downgrades reduce capacity and are not expansion rewards.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Storage Compacting crafts compressed items via permitted 2×2/3×3 recipes; it differs from Limited Barrel Compression.
